edits.new: | BR15 | The registry is read, not evaluated: this story never evaluates a package for a case, never caches a KieBase and never reads another service's schema. The PAYMENT_MATCH package is owned and evaluated by rwb-treatment (S2), and the matchPayments activity of rwb-payment asks S2 for the answer through S2's contract; this is an assumption until the package is authored. UNIVERSAL (R-UNI-01 to 50) is authored, scenario-tested and approved in rwb-decision (P7) and is evaluated in every service from its own copy of the same approved version | Arch v5 slide 27; DP-04; DP-05; GAP-2026; GAP-2034 |

Then the 93-table count of the legacy criterion is not asserted here, because it is the monolith schema's and RWB-P3-E2042-APP's

  Scenario: AC10 The version states and the business values are rows and parameters, and the package read evaluates nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the registry holds RESTRUCTURE, PAYMENT_MATCH and BOOKING_MATCH with their versions
    When the registry schema check and the package read run against rwb_decision
    Then the version states written are LOADED, APPROVED, IN_FORCE, SUPERSEDED, ROLLED_BACK and REFUSED and no other value
    Then the business values of BR13 are read from rule_package, rule_package_version and the parameters and none of them is code
    Then the package read evaluates no case, caches no KieBase and reads no other service's schema

  Scenario: AC11 The provided operations answer 401 without a caller, 403 to a caller without the right and 404 for an unknown version (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a request to the approve operation is sent without authentication
    When the request reaches POST /api/recovery/decision/v1/admin/rule-package-versions/{versionId}/approve
    Then the answer is 401 and no version state changes
    Given a caller without the Rules and parameters A right holds a LOADED version
    When the caller calls POST /api/recovery/decision/v1/admin/rule-package-versions/{versionId}/approve for that version
    Then the answer is 403 and the version stays LOADED with no approver
    Given no version carries the version identifier used in the call
    When a caller calls POST /api/recovery/decision/v1/admin/rule-package-versions/{versionId}/approve for that identifier
    Then the answer is 404 and no decision record is written

  Scenario: AC12 A replay of a write with the same idempotency key changes nothing and returns the answer of the first call (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given version RES-2026.12 was loaded by a write carrying an idempotency key
    When the same write is replayed with the same idempotency key
    Then no version row, rule row, test case or decision record is written a second time
    Then the answer is the answer of the first call
